about: Hand-maintained definition of the site's public routes and of the masthead navigation.
No page loads this file. The navigation markup stays static in each page. The engine's scripts/check_site_links.py reads this file and compares every composed page with it.
Edit it in the same change that adds, moves or removes a page, changes the navigation, or adds an address parameter or an anchor that a page creates at run time.

kinds.home: The homepage. It has the masthead. The wordmark links to it and the navigation does not, so no navigation link is marked current.
kinds.primary: A page with the masthead and a link in the primary navigation. Its own link carries aria-current="page".
kinds.more: A page with the masthead and a link inside the More disclosure. Its own link carries aria-current="page" and the summary reads "More · <label>".
kinds.detail: A page with the masthead that is opened from links another page builds. The navigation link named by "current" carries aria-current="page".
kinds.unlinked: A page with the masthead that no masthead links to. No navigation link is marked current. It stays noindex and keeps each "required_text".
kinds.error: The not-found page. It has the masthead with absolute links under base_path, because it is served at any depth. No navigation link is marked current.
kinds.redirect: A meta-refresh stub without the masthead. "redirect_to" is where it sends a reader.

fields.path: The route, relative to the site root. An empty path is the homepage; a path that ends with a slash is served from its index.html.
fields.title: The page's name. For a page in the navigation it is the link's label.
fields.hrefs: "absolute" where the navigation links start with base_path. Otherwise they are relative to the page, and a link to the page's own directory is "./".
fields.anchors: Established ids that links from outside the page rely on. Each must stay an id of an element in the page's source, whether or not a page of this site still links to it.
fields.generated: What the page reads from the address or creates at run time. "query" names address parameters. "fragment" gives a fragment that is not the id of any element in the source: "prefix" is its fixed start and "pattern" its full form. A link that uses one is listed by the check as declared; a link with a parameter or a fragment that is neither declared nor a static id is reported.
fields.noindex: true where the page must keep <meta name="robots" content="noindex">. The check reads it for an unlinked page.
fields.required_text: Text an unlinked page's source must keep.

generated.reason: The display index of the scenario to show, from scenario.index in data/simulated_scenarios.json. It is display order and can change on re-export.
The model whose measurements to show. Without it the page shows the base model.
The search text, the filters, the sort order and the open run. The page writes them to the address so a filtered view can be linked.
#s<N> selects scenario N in the scenario list. No element has this id: the page reads the fragment and draws that scenario.
The same selection as #s<N>, for a link that passes through software that removes fragments.
